rationale: P identifies the vehicle braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. SG-3 directly establishes this behaviour as the evaluation subject, and H-3 grounds it in sudden stopping without an obstacle ahead. The declared scope matches H-3's operational situation. P does not expand the phenomenon to include sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” is itself the subject required by the target, not merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon.
“Whether braking occurs and whether it is intended or unintended” directly addresses the property required to evaluate prevention of unintended braking.
The scope—straight-ahead travel at 50 km/h on a less frequented urban road, without visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, in good weather—is supported by H-3.
No additional observation, control-chain, warning, redundancy, or timing behaviour is incorporated into P.
